item.description: Gas prices continued to skyrocket this week as the war in Iran created havoc in the oil sector, but a handful of U.S. cities saw larger-than-average price increases.

item.title: Permanent injunction issued in religious-based abortion lawsuit
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS -- A Marion County court has granted an injunction barring the Hoosier state from enforcing its near-total abortion ban on individuals who have a religious exemption. In an order filed on Thursday in Marion County Superior Court, the court approved a permanent injunction preventing the state from enforcing Senate Enrolled Act 1 (SEA 1) [...]

item.title: People love to hate changing clocks twice a year, but can't agree how to fix it
item.description: Clocks will skip ahead an hour at 2 a.m. Sunday for daylight saving time in most of the U.S., creating a 23-hour day that throws off sleep schedules, plunges early-morning dog walks into darkness and inspires millions of complaints.

item.title: Oil surges to its highest price since 2023, and stocks drop after data shows a weaker US job market
item.description: Oil prices touched their highest levels since 2023 after surging again Friday because of the Iran war, while a weak update on the U.S. job market highlighted the economy's precarious position.

item.title: Storms as Saturday gets underway
item.description: After a Friday night round of storms that affected most spots from Fort Wayne northward (and only a few spots south), get ready for a higher - and more impactful - chance of storms Saturday morning, starting around sunrise. Storms will be widespread across northeast Indiana and northwest Ohio and some storms may be strong/severe. [...]

item.title: Man found guilty of role in 2023 fatal shooting, faces up to 137 years
item.description: These charges stem from the September 2023 fatal shooting of Ayvion Parker, who was found at the scene with multiple gunshot wounds, with his younger brother next to him, who had been shot in the leg.
